name: dynamics-connection-compatibility
title: Design the no-SDK Dynamics 365 access gateway
description: Design a shared, no-SDK Dynamics 365 8.2/9.1 Organization access gateway for five current products and future products, including profile-isolated connection-pool ownership, Web API compatibility, and a complete SDK-removal migration boundary.
creator: codex
notes: 2026-07-28 local Phase 4 hardening verified: ADFS/CRM HTTP isolation disables cookies/redirects/proxy/decompression/pre-auth; local admission is atomically bounded; local slots are atomic and expiry-fenced; token bodies are bounded, in-place parsed, and cleared; deterministic lease cleanup has no fire-and-forget/context-capture path. Fresh Dynamics tests pass 62/62 and Release build has 0 errors. Package01 remains false. Full Phase 4 still requires durable coordination, profile generation/drain, workload authentication, soak tests, and authenticated CE 8.2/9.1 evidence; apply the separate IFD correction only with a supported operator-side DWS credential.
